label: DATING AGAIN

cover.headline: 5 green flags *to notice early*
cover.sub: Because good signs deserve attention too.

points.heading: He’s consistent
points.body: His words and actions match from week to week.
points.panel: Notice whether plans he makes actually happen.

points.heading: He respects your no
points.body: A small no is met with ease, not pressure.
points.panel: Notice how he reacts when you change or decline a plan.

points.heading: He’s curious about you
points.body: He asks questions and remembers the answers.
points.panel: “What’s something he remembered that surprised me?”

points.heading: You feel calm with him
points.body: Not anxious, not guessing. Just at ease.
points.panel: “Do I feel like myself around him?”

points.heading: He’s kind to others
points.body: How he treats a server or a friend says a lot.
points.panel: Notice how he talks about people who aren’t in the room.

close.save: Save this for your next date.

caption:
We talk a lot about red flags. Green flags matter just as much, and they’re easy to miss when you’re braced for the worst.

These five quiet signs often point to someone steady and kind. Noticing them helps you trust what’s good.

Save this for your next date, and follow @roundabloom for more.
